description: Mark one client or project fact as no longer true. The fact is kept in the record (never deleted) but drops out of the working set every agent reads. Give a reason, and the key of the fact that replaces it if there is one.

client.description: Client name, @handle, or UUID (for a client fact).

key.description: The fact key, exactly as it appears in the context.

reason.description: Why it is no longer true.

superseded_by.description: Key of the fact that replaces it, if any.

name: retire_context_fact
title: Retire an out-of-date context fact
